test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f7592b15d905fa90953d58dfb195eed01cc5dba7bbea7c88661f5f399bb967.png]
solution:
In this case, we make two different arrangements of the digits from the positions of the dice. We note the digits in clockwise direction starting from the common digit. In both the arrangements, the digits written after the common digit are opposite to each other. 

 5 is the common digit in both the side, so the clockwise order of the digits is 

 5, 1, 4 (in first dice)

 5, 6, 3 (in the second dice)

Therefore, 1 is opposite to 6, 4 is opposite to 3 and 5 is opposite to 2(remaining digit).

Hence, the correct answer is .**5**
